# ckeditor5_phoenix v1.28.2 - Table of Contents

CKEditor 5 integration for Phoenix Framework

## Pages

- [CKEditor 5 Phoenix Integration](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [CKEditor5](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.md): The main module for CKEditor 5 integration in Phoenix Framework.

- [CKEditor5.Cloud](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Cloud.md): Represents the Cloud configuration for a CKEditor 5 preset.

- [CKEditor5.Cloud.AssetPackage](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Cloud.AssetPackage.md): Represents a single asset package containing JavaScript and CSS assets.
This module provides functionality to merge multiple asset packages.

- [CKEditor5.Cloud.AssetPackage.CKBox](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Cloud.AssetPackage.CKBox.md): Generates asset package URLs for CKBox.

- [CKEditor5.Cloud.AssetPackage.CKEditor5](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Cloud.AssetPackage.CKEditor5.md): Generates asset package URLs for CKEditor5 core files.

- [CKEditor5.Cloud.AssetPackage.CKEditor5PremiumFeatures](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Cloud.AssetPackage.CKEditor5PremiumFeatures.md): Generates asset package URLs for CKEditor5 Premium Features.

- [CKEditor5.Cloud.AssetPackage.JSAsset](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Cloud.AssetPackage.JSAsset.md): Represents a JavaScript asset in an asset package.

- [CKEditor5.Cloud.AssetPackageBuilder](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Cloud.AssetPackageBuilder.md): Module responsible for building asset packages for CKEditor5 cloud resources.
- [CKEditor5.Cloud.CKBox](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Cloud.CKBox.md): Represents the CKBox configuration for a CKEditor 5 preset.

- [CKEditor5.Cloud.CKEditorCloudUrlBuilder](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Cloud.CKEditorCloudUrlBuilder.md): Builds URLs for CKEditor 5 Cloud resources (CKEditor CDN and CKBox CDN).
Implements the CKEditor5.Cloud.UrlBuilder behavior.

- [CKEditor5.Cloud.UrlBuilder](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Cloud.UrlBuilder.md): Behavior for building URLs for CKEditor 5 Cloud resources.

- [CKEditor5.Components.AssignStyles](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.AssignStyles.md): Handles style assignments for the Editor component.

- [CKEditor5.Components.Cloud.Assets](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.Cloud.Assets.md): A component for rendering all necessary CKEditor 5 assets from the cloud.
This includes the import map, stylesheets, and UMD scripts.
- [CKEditor5.Components.Cloud.Assigns](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.Cloud.Assigns.md): Provides module responsible for creating %Cloud{} structures based on the provided assigns.

- [CKEditor5.Components.Cloud.Importmap](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.Cloud.Importmap.md): A component for rendering import map script tags of CKEditor 5 in Phoenix.
- [CKEditor5.Components.Cloud.ModulePreload](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.Cloud.ModulePreload.md): A component for rendering module preload link tags of CKEditor 5 in Phoenix.
- [CKEditor5.Components.Cloud.Stylesheets](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.Cloud.Stylesheets.md): A component for rendering stylesheet link tags of CKEditor 5 in Phoenix.
- [CKEditor5.Components.Cloud.UmdScripts](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.Cloud.UmdScripts.md): A component for rendering UMD script tags of CKEditor 5 in Phoenix.
- [CKEditor5.Components.Context](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.Context.md): A component for rendering a CKEditor5 context.

- [CKEditor5.Components.Editable](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.Editable.md): Live View component for rendering an editable area in CKEditor 5.
It may be used with decoupled editors or multiroot editors.

- [CKEditor5.Components.Editor](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.Editor.md): LiveView component for CKEditor 5 integration in Phoenix Framework.
- [CKEditor5.Components.Editor.Assigns](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.Editor.Assigns.md): Handles assigns processing for the Editor component.

- [CKEditor5.Components.Editor.AttributeValidator](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.Editor.AttributeValidator.md): Validates attributes for different editor types in the Editor component.

- [CKEditor5.Components.Editor.EditableHeightNormalizer](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.Editor.EditableHeightNormalizer.md): Normalizes and transforms values for the Editor component.

- [CKEditor5.Components.Editor.LanguageHandler](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.Editor.LanguageHandler.md): Provides a list of supported CKEditor 5 language codes and handles language code normalization for CKEditor integration.

- [CKEditor5.Components.Editor.PresetHandler](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.Editor.PresetHandler.md): Handles preset loading and type overriding for the Editor component.

- [CKEditor5.Components.Editor.PresetUploadHandler](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.Editor.PresetUploadHandler.md): Handles upload URL overrides for the Editor preset.

- [CKEditor5.Components.FormAttrs](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.FormAttrs.md): Common helper functions for CKEditor5 form components.

- [CKEditor5.Components.HiddenInput](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.HiddenInput.md): LiveView component for rendering a hidden input field.

- [CKEditor5.Components.LanguageNormalizer](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.LanguageNormalizer.md): Normalizes language codes for CKEditor integration.

- [CKEditor5.Components.UIPart](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Components.UIPart.md): Live View component for rendering a UI part of CKEditor 5, like a toolbar or a menubar.
It may be used with decoupled editors.

- [CKEditor5.Config](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Config.md): Provides access to CKEditor 5 configuration, specifically the presets defined in the application environment.
Prefer to not modify values too much, do it in other modules.

- [CKEditor5.Context](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Context.md): Represents the CKEditor 5 context configuration.

- [CKEditor5.Contexts](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Contexts.md): Provides predefined configurations (contexts) for CKEditor 5.

- [CKEditor5.CustomTranslations](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.CustomTranslations.md): Represents custom translations configuration for CKEditor5.

- [CKEditor5.Helpers](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Helpers.md): Common helper functions for CKEditor5 components.

- [CKEditor5.Installer](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Installer.md): Module responsible for downloading CKEditor 5 NPM packages into deps folder.

- [CKEditor5.Installer.NPMRegistry](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Installer.NPMRegistry.md): Module responsible for interacting with the NPM registry. It fetches and extracts NPM packages to certain locations.

- [CKEditor5.License](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.License.md): Provides functionality to manage CKEditor 5 license keys.

- [CKEditor5.Preset](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Preset.md): Represents a CKEditor 5 preset configuration.

- [CKEditor5.Preset.CloudCompatibilityChecker](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Preset.CloudCompatibilityChecker.md): Enforces business rules and compatibility constraints for CKEditor5 presets.
Specifically handles Cloud Distribution Channel licensing requirements and configuration validation.

- [CKEditor5.Preset.EditorType](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Preset.EditorType.md): Defines the available editor types for CKEditor5 presets.
This module provides a schema for the editor types and includes a function to validate them.

- [CKEditor5.Preset.Parser](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Preset.Parser.md): Parses CKEditor5 preset configurations.
Ensures that the configuration adheres to the expected schema and constraints.

- [CKEditor5.Presets](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Presets.md): Provides predefined configurations (presets) for CKEditor 5.

- [CKEditor5.Upload.Controller](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Upload.Controller.md): Controller for handling image uploads from CKEditor 5.

- Exceptions
  - [CKEditor5.Errors.CloudCannotBeUsedWithLicenseKey](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Errors.CloudCannotBeUsedWithLicenseKey.md): Exception raised when Cloud cannot be used with the provided license key.

  - [CKEditor5.Errors.CloudNotConfigured](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Errors.CloudNotConfigured.md): Exception raised when Cloud is not configured in the preset.

  - [CKEditor5.Errors.ContextNotFound](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Errors.ContextNotFound.md): Exception raised when a CKEditor5 context is not found.

  - [CKEditor5.Errors.Error](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Errors.Error.md): Represents an error in the CKEditor 5 integration.

  - [CKEditor5.Errors.InvalidCloudConfiguration](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Errors.InvalidCloudConfiguration.md): Exception raised when a Cloud configuration is invalid.

  - [CKEditor5.Errors.InvalidContext](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Errors.InvalidContext.md): Exception raised when a CKEditor5 context configuration is invalid.

  - [CKEditor5.Errors.InvalidCustomTranslations](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Errors.InvalidCustomTranslations.md): Exception raised when custom translations are invalid.

  - [CKEditor5.Errors.InvalidLicenseKey](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Errors.InvalidLicenseKey.md): Exception raised when an invalid license key is provided.

  - [CKEditor5.Errors.InvalidPreset](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Errors.InvalidPreset.md): Exception raised when a CKEditor5 preset configuration is invalid.

  - [CKEditor5.Errors.PresetNotFound](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/CKEditor5.Errors.PresetNotFound.md): Exception raised when a CKEditor5 preset is not found.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix ckeditor5.install](https://ckeditor5-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Ckeditor5.Install.md): Installs CKEditor 5 packages.
